title: Improper restriction of XML external entity references in Yamaha VOCALOID6 Editor
description: Yamaha VOCALOID6 Editor contains a vulnerability related to improper restriction of XML external entity (XXE) references. This flaw could potentially allow an attacker to exploit XML processing to access unauthorized resources or cause other impacts. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
aiSummary: The VOCALOID6 Editor software by Yamaha Corporation has an improper restriction of XML external entity references vulnerability. This means the software does not adequately restrict XML input that references external entities, which can lead to security issues such as disclosure of internal files or denial of service. No detailed technical information, affected versions, or exploitation details are provided in the source data.
aiImpact: The vulnerability could allow attackers to leverage XML external entity processing to access sensitive information or disrupt normal application behavior. However, no confirmed exploits or detailed impact scenarios are reported.
